# Harness core-alpha public references

Release-preparation citation catalog, frozen 2026-10-21. The catalog contains public bibliographic metadata, public URLs, and the locally recorded reading boundary. It does not turn a candidate list, metadata record, static case report, or local inference run into a full-paper audit or scientific acceptance. No new paper download or online metadata refresh was performed for this catalog.

The machine-readable records are in [`references.json`](references.json); the BibTeX export is in [`references.bib`](REFERENCES.bib). [`audit.json`](docs/ARCHIVE_POINTERS.md#archive-pointer-7b7e4e0b84c0b774) is a release-preparation receipt and is excluded from the public package. It contains only relative repository source names and hashes, never machine paths, session identifiers, or private chat URLs.

## Public-readiness and software sources

The catalog also records the existing official sources used to discuss release visibility, licensing, archive policy, and S4PRED implementation: the [Open Source Initiative FAQ](https://opensource.org/faq), [GitHub repository visibility documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/managing-repository-settings/setting-repository-visibility), [RCSB PDB policies](https://www.rcsb.org/pages/policies), and the versioned [S4PRED source repository](https://github.com/psipred/s4pred/tree/7f309dfc9a8155efdf30113fb4cb0affb40aeb7e). They are official guidance/software sources, not academic papers and not project certifications.

## Corrections and unknowns

- The effective DNABERT-2 citation is **arXiv 2306.15006v2**. The corpus explicitly marks the DOI in the frozen ledger as a review citation and records this correction in the current index only. This release catalog does not edit the original ledger.
- Unknown volume, pages, article numbers, authors, and publication versions remain `null`, `unknown`, or `partial` in `references.json`; no author, year, DOI, or page value was inferred from a model name.
- The 43-case index is a public identity index. It preserves the corpus reading scope (`existing_case_reports_and_selected_linked_material; not a new full-paper audit`) and does not claim that the count equals full reading.
- `audit.json` records the local source hashes and unresolved metadata so the public package can be reviewed without exposing local machine paths or session identifiers.
